svg.title: Fig 9 — Load cell: verifying every dispense
svg.desc: Strain principle of the bar load cell, the bridge to HX711 to micro:bit signal chain, the Z-shaped mount that carries the whole turret module (turret, floor plate, flush dosing disc, S2, bottom plate, S1, gears), and the per-drug weight bands and verdict order used to check every dispense.
svg.text: Fig 9 — Load cell: verifying every dispense
The whole turret module sits on one 1 kg bar load cell: strain gauges → Wheatstone bridge → HX711 → micro:bit → host weight check. Not to scale.
Smart Med Station · Hardware design v2.1 · 2026-10-07
Bar flexes a few microns; gauge resistance changes slightly.
Bend drawn hugely exaggerated. Ends stay parallel, so the bar takes an S-shape.
inside the load cell: 4 gauges = Wheatstone bridge
→ ≈ 3.3 mV at full 1 kg with 3.3 V excitation
DT LOW = ready → 25 pulses (24 data bits + 1 → gain 128 next read)
5 mm spacer ON TOP of free end
Load path forms a Z: platform → free-end spacer → bar → fixed-end spacer → housing floor. Bar = 1 kg cell (green).
No drum, no detent: the disc top is flush with the floor, and S1 holds the turret (gearbox + friction) until the disc is back at REST.
Dispense OK if drop = unit mass ± 1.2 g
drop = m_pre − m_post · each a median of 7 readings after a 1.0 s settle
grams = (raw − offset) ÷ scale on the host · scale ≈ 2,147 counts/g
Unit mass per drug (recorded at restock)
example demo assignment — host config, not hardware · each vial ±0.5 g
Verdict order (host, against the EXPECTED drug for that column)
first match wins · every verdict except OK → DISPENSE_FAULT + alarm
e.g. expect 12 g (col 6): 12.4 g → OK · 24.6 g → DOUBLE · 0.3 g → JAM · 9.2 g → MISLOAD · 4.0 g → FAULT
expect 6 g (col 0): 12.3 g → DOUBLE — checked before MISLOAD, so it is not read as midazolam
checked against the ledger; one missing vial's mass names its drug class
Unexplained mass change while idle → tamper flag
Calibrate: tare the empty module, then 20 US nickels = 100.0 g (5.000 g each)
